# Records cutover planning, 2026-02-10

Branch leads met to plan the cutover week for the [[Project Kestrel|catalog migration]]. Odile walked through the test load from January: 97 percent of bibliographic records matched cleanly, but item records with short barcodes failed to load.

## Decisions

- Branches circulate offline from March 9 to March 13 and record loans on paper slips.
- Cataloging stops for the week; see [[Decision - Freeze cataloging during cutover week#Exceptions]] for the two exceptions.
- Teodor reruns the export with the corrected barcode rule from the [[Bookwright export field map#Barcodes]].

## Open questions

- Whether holds placed during the offline week can be keyed in later or must be placed again.
- Who answers patron calls about missing loan history after go-live.
